observed_problem: Legacy scheduler repeatedly advanced last_run_time without creating/re-reading the owned automation_intelligence/flow heartbeat.
remediation: Disabled and explicitly retired the legacy scheduler object.
Created a fresh scheduler object from the current GitHub-connected runtime.
Made GitHub heartbeat write+readback the first substantive gate.
Kept automation_intelligence/flow as the only owned namespace and explicitly forbade omega_stack/flow.
acceptance: A new flow RUN_ID must appear first in owned heartbeat, then immutable history, latest, manifest flow entry, and finalized heartbeat.
